{{Top|leg}}
A '''sound suppressor''' was used by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] commandos to [[Blaster_suppressor|silence]] [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. The [[Endor strike team/Legends|Endor strike team]] carried these during their mission to destroy the [[Endor shield generator bunker]]. They were also used in the [[DC-19 "Stealth" carbine|DC-19 Stealth Carbine]] utilized by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].
